limits: Filesystem hashing cooperatively checks deadlines; it is not forcibly preempted. A live or nonjoining observer cannot qualify.
Same actual app process must remain observable after its UI method; missing/replaced process fails closed.
No physical-device, every-launch, full-SDK, release or full-bundle-equivalence acceptance is established by these source/controller checks.
prior_review_status: v2 source approval was held until the new finalizer finding was resolved; this report supersedes it.

resolved_findings.finding: Observer start outside cleanup boundary could leave a worker alive after partial-start cancellation.
resolved_findings.resolution: The same once-only start now occurs inside existing try/finally. Stop tolerates an unstarted Thread and joins a worker with a retained ident. Two controls execute the actual controller AST boundary and preserve original failure/export behavior.

resolved_findings.finding: New observer stop/final-bytes errors could replace an active original start/selection exception and skip later original evidence export.
resolved_findings.resolution: Only the new observer branch uses a once-only four-stage finalizer. Each action is independently attempted; fixed stage/error_type metadata records secondary failures, the active exception observed by sys.exception() is preserved, and absence of a primary raises the first finalizer failure after clearing observation. Other lane cleanup is unchanged.
resolved_findings.verification: Read complete finalizer and actual call boundary; six new controls execute the controller AST with real worker lifecycle and assert original exception object identity, exact evidence continuation, one call per failed action and selection, no-primary refusal, and private error text exclusion.

source_binding_verification: All six final files, exact reverse patch to each declared base, and all23 unchanged baseline inputs verified independently.
verified_invariants: Actual in-flight native phase receipt supplies the mapped PID; the new observer neither launches nor terminates an app. The old non-SDK wrapper retains its original single launch.

Original fixture bytes plus source/run/attempt, account/Space/document, native session/start and process identity are checked before, during and after mapping; atomic receipt replacement never qualifies a partial snapshot.

Installed/built executable and code-carrier hashes are bound before UI, during mapping and after UI. vmmap must show the actual PID, runtime and app entrypoint; actual entry/final UI hierarchy PIDs and post-UI process start identity must agree.
Mapping completion must fall within original native startedAt/finishedAt. The exact original final native receipt bytes are retained and hashed. No every-launch or full-bundle claim is introduced.

All 22 native checks and their independent validator are byte-unchanged; the actual driver remains unchanged and writes phase receipts atomically. Only entry/final hierarchy attachments were added to its existing UI method.

Every Properties branch in the acceptance controller is AST-identical to reconstructed exact Properties baseline; all 23 unchanged input files match their pins. Shared helpers preserve original default behavior outside the SDK lane.

Observation has 420-second waiting and 45-second shared mapping budget; read-only subprocesses use at most10 seconds and stop joins at most15 seconds. No app activation, account mutation or provider/consent injection was added.

New hanlin-native-only controls write into the precreated top-level evidence directory. Existing always-package and always-upload retain original failure-log bytes, verified using exact unchanged packager.

Partial-start and secondary-finalizer failures cannot qualify runtime success: observation is absent or cleared, worker lifecycle is bounded, and actual original error identity plus remaining evidence export are preserved by the new SDK branch.
